scientific_integrity: The new results concern exact tortoise-factor complexity of specified periodic binary words; the established operator and earlier general theorems are attributed, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete all-iteration formula applies only to periodic words with singleton 1-runs; general two-run words have an exact first-iterate spectrum only. The formulas are symbolic infinite-parametric proofs, with finite exhaustive tests as supplementary checks. Unindexed equivalent literature and independent external validation remain open.
title: Exact tortoise-complexity spectra for two-run periodic binary words
